scenes.eyebrow: SHARE KNOWLEDGE. KEEP THE WORK MOVING.
scenes.title: AgentContextAcrossPlatform
scenes.subtitle: Share the context. Continue the work.
scenes.caption: A reviewed handoff between people and their agents.
scenes.narration: Agent Context Across Platform. Share the session context, and let another person continue the work.

scenes.title: Two targets. One shared starting point.
scenes.subtitle: Reproduce context and capability. Resume without starting over.
targets: Can another team member reproduce your agent context and capability?
The task, history, selected files, tools and prerequisites.
Can a teammate pick up where your agent stopped?
The stopping point, unfinished work and next actions.
scenes.overview:
A tool / MCP integration that packages context, files and capability requirements
into a reviewed handoff for another person's agent.
scenes.caption: Preserve progress and known limits; continue with the recipient's own authorized environment.
scenes.narration: When an investigation pauses, can a teammate pick up where your agent stopped and reproduce its context and capability? Our project packages the task, history, selected files, capability requirements, and next steps into a reviewed handoff, so work can continue without starting over.

scenes.title: A transcript alone is not a working session.
scenes.subtitle: Three gaps separate sharing text from continuing the work.
cards:
Different agents.
Different formats.
Context limits.

Files and tools may differ.
Data access may be missing.
Readiness is not automatic.

Protect sensitive information.
Keep consent explicit.
Do not copy permissions.
scenes.caption: Restore context without pretending the recipient's environment is identical.
scenes.narration: The challenge goes beyond copying text. Agent formats differ, files and tools may be missing, and permissions do not transfer. We also need to protect sensitive information and make unknowns visible.

scenes.title: One share action. One continuation request.
scenes.subtitle: Simple outside. Reviewed and permission-aware inside.
parties:
Context + selected files
Capability requirements
Controlled sharing link

Open the link.
Continue in their own agent.
scenes.caption: Target experience. Existing authorization and supported-agent capabilities still apply.
scenes.narration: Ideally, the sender installs once and shares in one reviewed action. The recipient opens a controlled link and continues in their own agent. Capture, redaction, approval, and validation stay behind that simple experience.

scenes.eyebrow: DEMO / CURRENT SOLUTION AND NEXT STEP
scenes.title: Central server-based session handoff.
scenes.subtitle: We implemented the server-side workflow first.
scenes.caption: Now watch: share -> confirm -> publish -> resume -> continue.
scenes.narration: The current solution uses a central server to manage session snapshots and sharing links. We implemented this server-side workflow first. It can be hosted in a Web App once production controls are in place. Next, we will leverage SharePoint and OneDrive for secure, compliance-aligned file sharing.

scenes.title: Start with the task that needs a handoff.
scenes.subtitle: The captured state includes unfinished work and missing evidence
scenes.caption: An initial cloud-intent request; the demonstrated handoff uses the demo server.
scenes.narration: The flow begins with a share request for the current investigation. This first screen shows OneDrive intent, not a completed cloud upload. The demonstration then uses the handoff server.

scenes.title: Make the intended audience explicit.
scenes.subtitle: A recipient-selection prompt for the cloud path
scenes.caption: Audience selection is part of the planned cloud path, not evidence of a completed cloud grant.
scenes.narration: The proposed cloud path asks for specific recipients. This is an audience-selection prompt, not evidence that cloud access has already been granted.

scenes.title: Review before anything is published.
scenes.subtitle: Scope, omissions, destination and approval are visible
scenes.caption: Review the exact contents, destination and omissions. The human decides.
scenes.narration: The review shows the selected provider, destination, and omitted material. Secret detection is only an aid. Publication waits for the human to approve the exact contents and destination.

scenes.title: The server returns a shareable snapshot.
scenes.subtitle: The recorded result is a JSON summary and a snapshot link
scenes.caption: A point-in-time handoff, not a copy of the source machine or live runtime.
scenes.narration: After approval, the server returns a JSON snapshot and link. This is a reviewed summary, not the complete live runtime. The address shown here is the test instance of that service.

scenes.title: Resume with the recipient's target and workspace.
scenes.subtitle: The recorded request selects Copilot and the recipient's workspace
scenes.caption: Historical context is data. Source credentials and tool permissions do not transfer.
scenes.narration: The recipient supplies the snapshot link and selects Copilot and a workspace. Historical context can be imported, but source credentials, permissions, and tool connections do not transfer.

scenes.title: Pick up the investigation - with its limits.
scenes.subtitle: Recorded agent output, not an independent validation claim
scenes.caption: The screenshot reports a match. Cached rankings followed HTTP 403. SQL was not run.
scenes.narration: The recorded output reports restored context and a dataset match. It also discloses an access denial: popularity statistics came from cached rankings. No SQL was run.

scenes.title: SharePoint and OneDrive as the sharing foundation.
scenes.subtitle: A future rollout gate, not a compliance certification
cards:
Approved tenant and app.
Recipient-owned identity.
Specific-people access.

Minimal capture and redaction.
Explicit review.
Respect labels and restrictions.

Audit and lifecycle policy.
Expiry and revocation.
Live cross-user validation.
scenes.caption: The provider adapter exists; secure tenant rollout and compliance review remain ahead.
scenes.narration: Next, we will leverage SharePoint and OneDrive as a security- and compliance-aligned file-sharing foundation. The rollout will use approved identities, scoped recipients, and organizational data controls, with validation against tenant security and compliance requirements.
